Features

  • Advanced Unarmoured Movement

    Difficult Terrain doesn't slow you down and you can Jump an additional 6 m / 20 ft while you are not wearing armour or using a shield.

  • Darkvision

    Can see in the dark up to a certain distance.

  • Deflect Missiles

    Use your reaction to reduce the damage from a ranged weapon attack by 1d10 + your Dexterity Modifier + your monk level.

  • Evasion

    Successful DEX saves nullify damage; failed DEX saves reduce it by half.

  • Extra Attack

    Can make an additional attack after an unarmed or weapon attack.

  • Fast Hands

    Gain an extra bonus action.

  • Gnome Cunning

    You have  Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws.

  • Ki-Empowered Strikes

    Your unarmed attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming enemies' Resistance and Immunity to non-magical damage.

  • Martial Arts: Bonus Unarmed Strike

    After making an attack with a melee Monk weapon or while unarmed, you can make another unarmed attack as a bonus action.

  • Martial Arts: Deft Strikes

    Attacks with Monk Weapons and unarmed attacks deal 1d4⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage, unless their normal damage is higher.

  • Martial Arts: Dextrous Attacks

    Attacks with Monk weapons and unarmed attacks scale with your Dexterity instead of your Strength if your Dexterity is higher.

  • Opportunity Attack

    Attack an enemy moving out of reach.

  • Purity of Body

    You are Immune to Poison damage and can't be Poisoned or affected by disease thanks to the purifying ki flowing through your meridians.

  • Shortened Stride

    Your movement speed is 7.5 m (25 ft).

  • Slow Fall

    When you fall, you can use your reaction to gain Resistance to Falling damage.

  • Stillness of Mind

    If Charmed or Frightened, automatically cast Stillness of Mind to remove them.

  • Unarmoured Defence

    Your reflexes are as effective as any armour. While not wearing armour, you add your Wisdom Modifier to your  Armour Class.

  • Unarmoured Movement

    Your movement speed increases by 3 m (10 ft) while you are not wearing armour or using a shield.

Phase is a rock gnome monk and Zhent working as a mercenary for the Guild and  Nine-Fingers Keene. He is at the southwestern corner of the Guildhall, standing guard in the event of an attack by the  Stone Lord.
“
The Guild's no army, however tough they act. Just twenty different thieving crews, come to hide behind Nine-Fingers' skirts.
„
— Phase

Involvement

Protecting the Guildhall

Phase is first seen at the Guildhall, working as a mercenary for the Guild and guarding the Guildhall in the event of a potential attack by the  Stone Lord. He is not blind to  Nine-Fingers Keene looking down upon him and the rest of the Zhentarim, but despite this, he is certain that the guildmaster would nonetheless be glad to have him once the Stone Lord attacks,[1] and is eager to take the fight to the Stone Lord.[2]

Phase stands guard at X: -40 Y: 738, occasionally chatting with  Slick Inatra whenever she stops by. In fact, he is often chastised by her for his lack of hygiene and his tendencies for placing bets.[3][4] He also seems completely unaware of the Zhents' true purpose at the Guildhall.

Battle for the Guildhall

When  Roah Moonglow,  Boss Friol, or  Trinoda attempts to take over the Guildhall, Phase joins the fight alongside his Zhentarim allies against the Guild. Siding against the Zhentarim ends in Phase's demise, or in his disappearance if he is knocked out.[5]

If the party members side with the Zhentarim, win the battle, and he survives the fight in Guildhall, Phase moves to guard the door leading into the guildmaster's office.

Idle banter

  • Slick Inatra
    I told our clients we'd be on our best behaviour. Everyone playing nice here?
  • Phase
    Not playing at all, boss.
  • Slick Inatra
    Even better.
  • Slick Inatra
    Make sure the others keep to themselves. This place is jumpy - better to give the Guildies their space.
  • Phase
    'S not like we're bloody diseased, boss.
  • Slick Inatra
    Worse, Phase - we're Zhentarim.
  • Phase
    What are we waiting for, Inatra? If we're meant to fight this Stone Lord, then let's bloody be about it.
  • Slick Inatra
    See my uniform, Phase? It's nicer than yours, agreed? And not just because I don't sleep in it.
  • Slick Inatra
    That's because I outrank you. So when I say that I haven't even been told our orders yet, I want you to believe me.
  • Phase
    Yes. Sergeant.
  • Slick Inatra
    I'd also like you to bathe sometime this tenday.
  • Phase
    Yes, sergeant.
  • Phase
    The locals going to kick us out, sergeant?
  • Slick Inatra
    Just you, Phase. You rob the place of its glamour.
  • Phase
    No loss. Last time I was here they had dice, blood-bouts, the works. Now it's just a lot of sulking pickpockets.
  • Slick Inatra
    Those sulks are paying us, Phase. So chin up, make your coin, and you can lose it somewhere else. Aye?
